    Overview

    National Commodity & Derivatives Exchange Limited (NCDEX) is a nation-level, technology driven on-line recognised stock exchange with an independent Board of Directors and professional management. It is committed to provide a commodity Exchange platform for market participants to trade in a wide spectrum of commodity derivatives.
